s1.syndrome_frame: mediastinal mass with respiratory and vascular symptoms
key_facts: 12 cm mass in the anterior superior mediastinum
invasion of the superior vena cava
thrombus extending into the left brachiocephalic trunk
treated with heparin and high-dose corticosteroids
histopathology showed multinodular proliferation of small, round, monomorphic cells
immunohistochemistry demonstrated diffuse strong WT1 positivity

raw.syndrome_frame: mediastinal mass with respiratory and vascular symptoms

shortlist.label: Ewing sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: small round cell morphology and CD99 positivity

shortlist.label: CIC-rearranged sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: diffuse strong WT1 positivity and clinical presentation

shortlist.label: Desmoplastic small round cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: histological mimic with small round cell morphology

shortlist.label: BCOR-CCNB3 sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: small round cell morphology and WT1 positivity

raw.rationale: The patient's histopathology showing multinodular proliferation of small, round, monomorphic cells with clear cytoplasm and immunohistochemistry demonstrating diffuse strong WT1 positivity are characteristic of desmoplastic small round cell tumor, despite the lack of EWSR1 translocation typically associated with Ewing sarcoma.

rejected.label: Ewing sarcoma
rejected.why: Atypical pattern and lack of characteristic EWSR1 translocation

rejected.label: CIC-rearranged sarcoma
rejected.why: No specific molecular evidence provided to support this diagnosis

rejected.label: BCOR-CCNB3 sarcoma
rejected.why: No specific molecular or histological evidence provided to support this diagnosis
